# Vendored QR encoder

This directory contains the QRCode for JavaScript encoder by Kazuhiko Arase, vendored for local-only Saatyar pairing QR generation.

- Original project: QRCode for JavaScript (2009)
- Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase
- License: MIT
- No network service is used to generate pairing QR codes.

The files retain their original copyright/license headers. The CommonJS file extensions and local `require` paths were adjusted for the Saatyar ESM repository.
